maintenance_led.reason: Revenue mainly from selling pulse oximetry monitors, boards and sensors; mostly new device sales plus disposable sensors, not repair or maintenance services.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are hospitals and clinicians, paid largely by commercial insurers and private payers; government share is not the majority.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through its own noninvasive monitoring innovation (smart SET, SedLine, Root); only occasional acquisitions like LiDCO, and now part of Danaher.

mission_critical.reason: Pulse oximetry and Root monitoring are FDA-cleared, clinically embedded in hospital workflows and OEM products; switching requires validation and retraining.

notes: Website says Masimo is now part of Danaher; answered for Masimo's patient monitoring business.
